description.fun: Solrock soaks up sunlight in groups during the day and is believed to have come from space, perhaps from the sun itself. It spins its body to give off intense heat and a blinding light. Its face never changes expression, but it can sense the thoughts and feelings of those around it. In Pokémon GO it's mostly found in the Eastern Hemisphere, and Lunatone in the Western.
description.guide: A Rock- and Psychic-type Pokémon shaped like the sun, which floats silently and draws power from sunlight. It lives in caves and is the counterpart of Lunatone. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: A sun-shaped meteorite that spins out blinding light
